biotools.summary: Bioinformatics pipeline for the analysis of next-generation sequencing data derived from intra-host viral populations.

documentation.note: Tutorial: how to use V-pipe (specifically for SARS-CoV-2 data).
Webinar: Applying V-pipe to SARS-Coronavirus-2 data

function.cmd:
curl -O 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cbg-ethz/V-pipe/master/utils/quick_install.sh'
bash quick_install.sh -b sars-cov2 -p V-pipe-installation/ -w working/
cd V-pipe-installation/working/
mkdir -p samples/patient_1/20200409/raw_data
cp ~/Download/reads_R{1,2}.fastq.gz samples/patient_1/20200409/raw_data/
./vpipe -p --cores 2

ls samples/patient_1/20200409/variants/SNVs/snvs.vcf
ls samples//variants/SNVs/REGION_*/support/*.fasgz
function.note: Please consult wiki or tutorial for the directory structure of the raw reads input.

biotools.name: V-pipe

publication.note: V-pipe is used within the S3C (Swiss SARS-CoV-2 Sequencing Consortium) to provide sequences.
V-pipe was used to process a major part of the Swiss samples in this pan-European study.
V-pipe and the S3C (Swiss SARS-CoV-2 Sequencing Consortium) infrastructure were used to QA and pre-process the sequencing data.
